title: CashShop
description: A cashshop used for modpack or server to sell items, armor or other think using copper, silver and gold currency.
body:
It allows modpackers to create a cash shop using KubeJS only, without any configuration files:.

(I would have liked to use the Grand Fantasia UI instead of the Minecraft one, but it’s too large :'D)

- To open the shop, press I (by default), you can change the key inside the key menu.
- You can use the command /shop_set_currency (gold) (silver) (copper) or /shop_add_currency (gold) (silver) (copper), no need to specify a player, it's for yourself (require creative or more).
- Additionally you can give the coins from this mod, they will convert to the cash shop currency inside the inventory or picked up from the floor if you make a entity drop it.

Warning:

    The cash shop GUI is less large with the version 0.0.2 but still a bit big for a 800x600 screen size.

Mod supported:

    JEI: Curseforge Enables the JEI UI to adapt to the shop UI size.

Check this for commands and examples of scripts: [KubeJS Commands]([https://github.com/TokyoSU/CashshopMod?tab=readme-ov-file#kubejs-commands](https://github.com/TokyoSU/CashshopMod?tab=readme-ov-file#kubejs-commands))
